rules.text: No insults or harassment of other members.
No scam, phishing or wallet-drainer links, any offence.
No spam: the same message repeated or flooding a channel.
No impersonating the team or moderators.

cases.evidence:
[14:02 #general] ardal: when does the team unlock start? the docs say Q4, the dashboard says November
[14:03 #general] ardal: not trying to fud, just want to plan
cases.statement: I asked in #general when the team unlock starts and was banned a minute later for FUD. I did not insult anyone or post a link.
cases.reply: Rule 1 is about insults and harassment. Asking which date in the docs is right is neither.
